description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Free to call. Read-only poll for any single render you own -- a transparent video created via create_transparent_video, or any other render id. Reports status and the result video URL(s) once done.
name: get_render_status
title: Check a render's status
